entry.title: Set up your dot in the ChatGPT mobile app

media:group.media:title: Set up your dot in the ChatGPT mobile app
media:group.media:description:
You can now create a dot from the ChatGPT mobile app. Set up your dot, edit the name, customize the avatar, and set your dot to be the first conversation you see when you open the ChatGPT app.
Learn more about dots here: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/dots

media:group.media:title: Building the Codex community
media:group.media:description: See how the Codex community brings people together to build, learn, and share. Pauline Narvas and VB talk about growing the Codex Ambassador program, their favorite moments from local meetups and Build Week, and what it means to build with heart.

entry.title: How Sophos cuts threat response time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak

media:group.media:title: How Sophos cuts threat response time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
media:group.media:description:
Sophos CTO John Peterson shares how agents built through OpenAI Daybreak combine AI with Sophos’s cybersecurity expertise to reduce average response time from 38 minutes to 89 seconds for cases using those agents. Hear how Sophos is helping its MDR team investigate threats faster, protect customers at scale and keep human judgement at the centre.
Read the full customer story - https://openai.com/index/sophos/

entry.title: Production Monitoring with Codex: Grafana, Kubernetes, & Security

media:group.media:title: Production Monitoring with Codex: Grafana, Kubernetes, & Security
media:group.media:description:
It’s 3 a.m. and checkout errors are climbing. What do you check first?
Join cohosts Tony Loehr and Anke Hao for three practical production-monitoring demos with Codex. Follow a checkout failure in Grafana, investigate a Kubernetes rollout that causes out-of-memory restarts, and explore how a Codex Security finding connects service availability to a missing resource limit.
See how telemetry, release history, and code support an investigation; learn how engineers review a proposed change and check the result.

entry.title: More visual answers from GPT-6 with Intelligent UI

media:group.media:title: More visual answers from GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
media:group.media:description:
GPT‑6 in ChatGPT introduces Intelligent UI, a new capability that allows ChatGPT to answer quickly with fully interactive user interfaces that make everyday answers more visual, make learning complex topics easier and that can quickly create a tool to solve a task right in the moment.
GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI is rolled out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers in the Chat tab. Starting today, the rollout expands to Free and Go tiers. Enterprise availability depends on workplace admin settings.
GPT‑6 in ChatGPT is powered by GPT‑6 Sol for Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers, and GPT‑6 Luna for Free and Go tiers. Both are tuned for everyday conversation.
This update applies to the Chat experience in ChatGPT. The models powering Work and Codex are not changing as part of this release.

entry.title: How Oracle Uses ChatGPT Work to Transform Recruitment

media:group.media:title: How Oracle Uses ChatGPT Work to Transform Recruitment
media:group.media:description:
“We’ve gone from zero to 100, not zero to 60.”
Jan Ackerman shares how Oracle built a talent market intelligence tool with ChatGPT Work to transform hiring preparation.
Starting with a job description, it researches comparable roles, benchmarks compensation, and assesses talent pools across locations, giving hiring managers consistent data and insights.
Read how Oracle is transforming work with ChatGPT Work and Codex: https://openai.com/index/oracle/

entry.title: Introducing GPT-6 in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI

media:group.media:title: Introducing GPT-6 in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI
media:group.media:description:
ChatGPT just got a lot more visual—introducing Intelligent UI.
Intelligent UI allows ChatGPT to answer quickly with fully interactive user interfaces that make everyday answers more visual. It makes learning complex topics easier, and it quickly creates tools to solve a task right in the moment.
Oh, and also...GPT-6 is coming to ChatGPT. For everyone. GPT‑6 in ChatGPT is powered by GPT‑6 Sol for Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers, and GPT‑6 Luna for Free and Go tiers.
GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI starts rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers today in the Chat tab.
Starting tomorrow, the rollout expands to Free and Go tiers.
https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/
